title: Poplar to Maple
description: Makes the new poplar items into maple versions of themselves (mostly the tree blocks)
body:
This is a pack that changes the new poplar tree items into maple versions of themselves, while retaining their original color palette!

Currently supports leaves, their particles, the sapling, and both stripped and regular logs and wood!

![A showcase of the items the pack changes into maple](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/RLfnqoXh/images/45f15ea7b3c105d6da3f0c13e23e151db31009e9.png)
